en: "Team Convert"{SAUT}You have gained the ability to change your{SAUT}team in the middle of combat. Press the Y{SAUT}Button on the CONVERT screen to perform{SAUT}this action, known as a {f 0 1 2}Team Convert{f 0 1 0}.
"Team Convert"{SAUT}After you initiate Team Convert, the{SAUT}current team will use each of their turns{SAUT}to defend until the other team arrives.
"Team Convert"{SAUT}Enemies will still be able to act during{SAUT}this time, but the arrival of the new team{SAUT}might cancel such actions.
Using Team Convert will not cause any{SAUT}Shadows that are knocked down to recover{SAUT}any faster than they normally would.
Go for All-out Attacks by swapping in{SAUT}teams that would be ideal for fighting the{SAUT}particular Shadows you're up against.
